    count = len(numbers)
    average = total / count

    # Step 3: Round the average to the nearest integer
    rounded_average = round(average)

    # Step 4: Output the rounded average
    return rounded_average

print(solve_problem())

\[ \text{Volume} = \frac{\text{Mass}}{\text{Density}} \]

Given the problem, we know the mass of the object is 20 kg and the density of the material is 10 kg/m³. We can plug these values into the formula to find the volume.
